dream: I pressed the eleven point two gigabytes into a pointy triangle while sleeping. The sharp tip caught the lazy top edge of the wide rectangle, but the heat made the tip weep. I wedged the triangle under the sliding top, hoping to stop the warm honey from spilling. The frame felt sharp, then slippery. I learned that fifty-seven degrees was not a number, but a hand stretching the corner wide until it dissolved into soft gum.
